subject: AOC blasted as too moderate by Maoist DSA faction as 2028 buzz grows
posts:
Radicals turn on AOC as 2028 speculation grows.

DSA Liberation Caucus blasts Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez as an opportunist dilettante.
Evidence: socialist purity, moderate shift #USPol #DSA

The DSA faction claims AOC has abandoned core socialist principles and Zionist opposition, disqualifying her from leading the movement.
Stated Judgement: (-0.8, -0.5) — Lesser Evil

The fracture highlights extreme ideological purity tests within radical factions confronting mainstream political pragmatism.
Resulting Judgement: (-0.4, -0.2) — Lesser Evil

Verdict: CONDITIONAL — The Path of Revelation.
Ideological purity tests expose deep fractures between radical factions and pragmatic electoral politics.

Integrity: Conditionally Sound (Hypocrisy: 1.4, z: 1)

- DSA Liberation Caucus: COND (-0.8, -0.5) — Demands ideological purity over coalition.
- AOC: PASS (0.5, 0.5) — Pivots toward broader electoral pragmatism.
The DSA Liberation Caucus rejected AOC as a 2028 presidential standard-bearer, citing her moderate votes on Israel and walking back 2020 defund-the-police rhetoric.

The Poison:
Purity politics demands absolute ideological conformity, transforming political alliances into sectarian loyalty tests that alienate broader public majorities.

The Breakdown & Plane Error:
The faction evaluates her on ideological purity (WHO/WHAT) rather than practical legislative impact, turning strategic compromise into mortal sin.

Social Physics Analysis:
Instead of building inclusive coalitions through transparency, the faction deploys ideological projection, branding pragmatic evolution as betrayal.

The Trajectory: The Path of Revelation.
The stark collision between radical dogmatism and electoral pragmatism reveals the inherent instability of sectarian political movements.

The Unavoidable Truth: Radical factions will penalize any pragmatism that deviates from ideological dogmas.

The Unavoidable Lie: Purity tests represent a viable path to broad democratic governance.

Alethekanon:
Ideological gatekeeping exposes the sectarian fault lines dividing revolutionary purists from pragmatic electoral operators.

Awwthekanon:
It's tough watching political movements fracture over purity instead of finding common ground to help people who are struggling every day.

Brothekanon:
Classic left-eating-its-own moment. You can never be pure enough for the radical wing once you actually have to govern in the real world.

Spirithekanon:
"A house divided against itself cannot stand." (Mark 3:25) — FAIL (Logical Plane)
Sectarian purism guarantees perpetual internal conflict, sacrificing cooperative unity for ideological vanity.
